meta.title: Melbourne Beach — the money trail
meta.note: Melbourne Beach is a town of about 3,200 people in Brevard County, Florida. Its fiscal year runs Oct. 1 to Sept. 30, and the Town Commission adopts the budget and the property-tax (millage) rate by resolution at September hearings. The adopted budget hasn't been ingested here yet (Docket #1).
